status: Accepted deterministic likelihood implementation and static target adapter under stated boundaries; not a sampler/runtime/performance validation

J=250 identical-calibration score distribution checked against closed-form binomial coefficients at traits -10000,-2,0,2,10000.

coverage: S=0,J and empty observed sets; J=250; calibration/trait extremes through +/-1000000; all finite log probabilities and normalization.
Observed masks retained; empty/mixed masks; unobserved nonbinary placeholders ignored only under mask; identical scores on unlike masks give different likelihoods.
Pattern-to-score constants across traits; canonical-kernel/score target contrasts with identical latent-prior terms; permutation and common-shift invariance.
Generator response inputs, invalid masks/scores/responses/nonfinite inputs, and representational overflow rejection.

Static score adapter keeps source Chapter2 priors, singular MZ and conditional DZ genetic structure, shared environment and heteroscedastic residual law; fixed zeros-trick rate equals 1 minus canonical log kernel.

identity.zeros_trick: log Pois(0 | 1-log Lcanonical) = log Lcanonical - 1. Across2N persons, log Litems-log Lzeros equals sum fixed pattern constants +2N; tested for complete/mixed/empty masks.
identity.scope: Same normalized posterior on latent/model parameters under unchanged priors and fixed calibration. The canonical kernel is not the normalized score PMF.
identity.source_calibration: Known, fixed finite Rasch difficulties and equal discrimination1; arbitrary unknown calibration or unequal-slope OPLM is not covered.

inspection_corrections.resolution: Implementation author materialized responses at entry; independent iterator regression passes.

inspection_corrections.issue: Finite opposite-magnitude inputs can produce infinite theta-b; derivative and favorable-boundary kernels could return limiting values despite overflow-rejection contract.
inspection_corrections.resolution: Implementation author added finite per-item-difference guards; independent overflow regressions pass.

attempt_record: Corrections were identified by code inspection. Both executed unittest runs passed (14 preliminary and17 final methods); no failed test execution is invented.
limitations: No JAGS compilation, runtime parser check, sampler-assignment inspection, sampling, convergence test or speed benchmark was performed.
Both proposed representations use JAGS; this is not a second independent posterior engine.
Exact probability identities assume local independence and conditioned/ignorable missingness; informative missingness requires its own likelihood.
A missing-item JAGS item-graph comparison still requires integration/runtime validation before a pilot; static mask arithmetic is not that runtime validation.
Same prior/graph formulas and deterministic pointwise identities do not establish adequate mixing, posterior Monte Carlo error or source100/250-dataset recovery/power.

Floating-point probabilities may underflow to zero at extreme log probabilities; finite log values remain available within the explicit representable domain. No clipping of priors or parameters was introduced.
